summary: Amazon.com, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the closing of a registered public offering of debt securities, including floating-rate notes and fixed-rate notes across eight tranches, with an aggregate public offering price of $24.923 billion and estimated net proceeds of approximately $24.867 billion. The offering was conducted pursuant to an underwriting agreement dated July 7, 2026, with Barclays, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley as lead underwriters. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation; it involves ordinary debt issuance for general corporate purposes, with no unusual structural features or event-driven catalysts. No special-situation classification applies.
